ING Hubs Romania offers 130 services in software development, data management, non-financial risk & compliance, audit, and retail operations to 24 ING units worldwide, with the help of over 2000 high-performing engineers, risk, and operations professionals. We started out in 2015 as ING’s software development hub, then steadily expanded our range to include more services and competencies. Now we provide borderless services with bank-wide capabilities and operate in Bucharest. Our tech capabilities remain the core of our business, with more than 1800 colleagues active in Data Management, Touchpoint Channels & Integration, Core Banking, and Global Products. We enjoy a flexible way of working and a highly collaborative environment, where fair and constructive feedback is encouraged. For us, impact isnt a perk. Its the driver of our work. We are guided and rewarded by a shared desire to make the world a better place, one innovative solution at a time. Our colleagues make it their job to do impactful things and they love doing it in good company. Do you?

The MissionWe as Service & Delivery enhance operational reliability and efficiency by implementing, optimizing, and governing ITSM processes across multiple domains, ensuring consistent service delivery and operational excellence.We coordinate, monitor, and report on change activities while facilitating the planning, execution, and oversight of cross-platform resilience initiatives, including DDoS simulations, disaster recovery testing, and business continuity exercises. We collaborate with global process owners, service providers, and SRE teams to ensure alignment on processes, best practices, and supported tooling.As part of the Service & Delivery team, you will help implement and improve IT Service Management processes, governing change and configuration management activities, and supporting resilience initiatives. You will work closely with engineering teams, service providers, and stakeholders to drive operational excellence, standardization, and continuous improvement, ensuring reliable and efficient service delivery.Your day to dayConfiguration Manager: Maintains the integrity of configuration data by governing CMDB processes, ensuring accurate tracking of configuration items and dependenciesChange
